tools.name: CreateRecord
tools.description:
Create a new record in Attio.

Always creates a new record — does not check for duplicates.
For upsert (create or update) behavior, match on a unique attribute instead.

Example values for a deal:
{"name": "Acme Corp Deal", "stage": "Qualified"}

Example values for a person:
{"name": [{"first_name": "Jane", "last_name": "Doe"}],
 "email_addresses": [{"email_address": "user1@example.com"}]}

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: The type of object to create a record for. Standard object types are 'people', 'companies', and 'deals'. Custom object types are the API slug of the object.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Attribute values to set on the new record

output.description: Created record info including record_id and web_url

value.name: Acme Corp Deal
value.description: Q3 enterprise contract for Acme Corp

tools.name: CreateTask
tools.description:
Create a task in Attio.

Tasks are useful for follow-ups, reminders, and action items.
Optionally link to a record by providing both linked_record_id and linked_record_object.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Task description

parameters.name: assignee_id

parameters.name: deadline

parameters.name: linked_record_id

parameters.name: linked_record_object
parameters.description: The type of object to link to the task. Standard object types are 'people', 'companies', and 'deals'. Custom object types are the API slug of the object. Defaults to no linked record.

tools.name: GetCallTranscript
tools.description:
Get the full transcript from a call recording.

Returns the transcript with speaker labels. Use this after finding a meeting
that has a call recording, along with its call_recording_id.

The transcript includes:
- Full raw transcript text
- Segmented transcript with speaker names
- Call duration and participant info

parameters.name: meeting_id
parameters.description: Meeting UUID

parameters.name: call_recording_id
parameters.description: Call recording UUID

parameters.name: include_timestamps
parameters.description: Include start/end times for each segment. Defaults to False.

tools.name: GetDealTranscript
tools.description:
Convenience tool to get a call transcript for a deal in one step.

Finds meetings for the deal, gets the specified meeting's call recording,
and returns the full transcript. Defaults to the most recent meeting.

This combines finding the deal's meetings and fetching a call transcript into one call.
Returns an error if no meetings with recordings are found.

parameters.name: deal_record_id
parameters.description: Deal record UUID

parameters.name: meeting_index
parameters.description: Which meeting (0=most recent, 1=second most recent). Defaults to 0.

tools.name: SaveRecord
tools.description:
Create or update (upsert) a record using Attio's assert endpoint.

This is idempotent - safe to retry. If a record matching the attribute exists,
it will be updated. Otherwise, a new record is created.

IMPORTANT: The matching_attribute MUST be a unique attribute on the object.
Common unique attributes:
- people: 'email_addresses'
- companies: 'domains'
- deals: 'record_id' (name is NOT unique by default)

To update a deal by name, first query to get the record_id, then update the record by that ID.

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: The type of object to upsert a record for. Standard object types are 'people', 'companies', and 'deals'. Custom object types are the API slug of the object.

parameters.name: matching_attribute
parameters.description: Unique attribute for upsert match (e.g., 'email_addresses', 'domains')

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Attribute values to set on the record

values.value: {"name": "Acme Corp", "domains": ["acme.com"], "description": "A global leader in innovative solutions", "employee_count": 500, "industry": "Technology"}

tools.name: UpdateRecord
tools.description:

Use this when you have the record_id and want to update specific fields.
This doesn't require a unique matching attribute.

For status fields like 'stage', pass the status title as a string:

For date fields, use ISO format:
{"close_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: The type of object to update a record for. Standard object types are 'people', 'companies', and 'deals'. Custom object types are the API slug of the object.

parameters.name: record_id
parameters.description: Record UUID to update

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Attribute values to update on the record

value.name: Enterprise Expansion - Q2
value.notes: Final contract signed; onboarding scheduled for July.

summary:
Arcade's Attio toolkit enables LLMs to interact with the [Attio CRM](https://attio.com) via 20 tools covering the full CRM workflow — reading, writing, and organizing data across records, lists, meetings, and tasks.

## Capabilities

- **Workspace discovery & identity** — Enumerate all objects (standard and custom), lists, and workspace members; retrieve the authenticated user's profile and permissions as a starting point for any workflow.
- **Record management** — Create, get, query (with filtering/pagination), upsert (`SaveRecord`), and update records across any object type (people, companies, deals, custom objects); schema inspection via `GetObjectSchema` surfaces attribute slugs, types, and valid option values before filtering.
- **List operations** — List all workspace lists, add records to lists with optional entry-level attributes, retrieve list entries, and remove entries by entry ID.
- **Notes & tasks** — Log notes against any record for activity history; create and list tasks with optional record linkage and assignee/completion filtering.
- **Meetings & call transcripts** — List meetings linked to any record, retrieve meeting details (including call recording metadata), fetch full call transcripts with speaker labels and participant info, or use the convenience tool to pull a deal's transcript in a single call.

## OAuth

Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 via the **Attio** provider. See the [Arcade Attio auth provider docs](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/references/auth-providers/attio) for configuration details.
